en: The machines I needed to reach kept ending up somewhere unreachable: a server behind NAT, a Raspberry Pi at home, an office PC behind a firewall, a router that only lets HTTPS out.

Port forwarding needs a router you control, a VPN needs software on every laptop, and both need someone to maintain them. Every one of those devices could already reach the internet, judging by how often they download updates. So Telepy turns the connection around: the device dials out, and you work on it from the browser.
zh: 我需要連的機器，總是待在連不到的地方：NAT 後面的伺服器、家裡的樹莓派、防火牆後的辦公室電腦、只放 HTTPS 出去的路由器。
開 port forwarding 要能管路由器，VPN 要每台筆電都裝軟體，兩者都得有人維護。但這些裝置自己上網都沒問題，看它們多常下載更新就知道。所以 Telepy 把連線方向倒過來：裝置往外撥，你在瀏覽器裡操作它。

note.en: REST · WebSockets · SSH gateway · monitor · SQLite
note.zh: REST · WebSocket · SSH gateway · 監控 · SQLite

tunnel.en: reverse SSH, dialed out by the device
tunnel.zh: 反向 SSH，由裝置往外撥

items.en: One command on Linux, macOS and OpenWrt, followed live until Telepy can log in
items.zh: Linux、macOS、OpenWrt 貼一行指令，頁面即時跟到 Telepy 能登入為止

items.en: A step-by-step wizard with ready-made scripts for Windows, Docker and appliances
items.zh: Windows、Docker 與各種設備有逐步精靈和現成腳本

items.en: SSH inside a WebSocket on the web port when only HTTPS gets out
items.zh: 只有 HTTPS 出得去時，把 SSH 包進 WebSocket 走網頁埠

items.en: Health, per-hop latency and search that understands status:down or label:env=prod
items.zh: 健康狀態、每一跳延遲，搜尋看得懂 status:down 或 label:env=prod

items.en: Web terminal with tabs, Nerd Fonts, a toolbox of saved commands and recordings
items.zh: 網頁終端機：分頁、Nerd Fonts、常用指令工具箱、操作錄影

items.en: File manager with an editor that never saves half a file
items.zh: 檔案管理，內建的編輯器不會只存一半

items.en: RDP and VNC through the tunnel, or RustDesk in the tab
items.zh: 透過隧道開 RDP、VNC，或直接在分頁裡用 RustDesk

items.en: A real Chromium that goes online from the device, for admin pages that only open on that network
items.zh: 從裝置那端上網的 Chromium，專門開那些只有內網看得到的管理頁

items.en: View, edit or admin sharing with expiry; removing someone ends their sessions at once
items.zh: 檢視、編輯、管理三種分享層級，可設到期；移除權限的當下就切斷連線

items.en: Command rules that block, hold for approval or remind, for people and MCP agents alike
items.zh: 指令規則可以封鎖、等待核准或提醒，對人和 MCP agent 一視同仁

items.en: Watch a live terminal, hand over the keyboard, or end a session
items.zh: 即時看別人的終端機、交出鍵盤、或結束連線

items.en: Tamper-evident audit logs, recordings and sign-in history
items.zh: 防竄改的稽核紀錄、錄影與登入歷史

items.en: telepy CLI: ls, ssh, exec on twenty devices at once, cp
items.zh: telepy CLI：ls、ssh、一次對二十台 exec、cp

items.en: REST API with scoped personal tokens, device limits, expiry and a call log
items.zh: REST API：可限定範圍、裝置與期限的個人 token，每次呼叫都有紀錄

items.en: MCP endpoint so Claude Code or Cursor can work on devices, every call logged
items.zh: MCP 端點，讓 Claude Code 或 Cursor 操作裝置，每次呼叫都記錄
